Class HtmlTestReport

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.dev.test.report.HtmlTestReport
All Implemented Interfaces:
Ordered, TestEventListener, TestReportListener
public final class HtmlTestReport extends Object implements TestReportListener
The live HTML report of test mode, for every build tool: a page of the latest result of every test, failures first, with their stack traces linked to the sources, their captured output, the last runs, and a change that did not compile.

The report keeps its results as the JUnit XML reports do, see TestResults, and writes index.html and state.json to micronaut.dev.test.html-report, by default build/micronaut-dev/test-report, whenever a run starts or finishes, a change does not compile or compiles again, and test classes are deleted. The page holds its state, so it opens from the file system as it is. With micronaut-dev-livereload on the classpath the LiveReload server serves the directory, at http://localhost:35729/tests/, and the report publishes every event on the tests topic of its event channel, so the open page follows a run test by test without reloading.

Since:
5.3.0

graemerocher
